headline: Found rent increase fair in Fernandez complaint and approved a vacate agreement in Hax dispute.
summary: The commission heard testimony in the complaint by Joan Fernandez against Garden Homes Management Corporation and voted that the rent increase was fair and equitable. In a separate complaint by Barbara Hax against Lawrence Zolnik, the parties presented a settlement agreement covering vacating the premises, rent amount, and notice terms, which both parties confirmed on the record.
decisions: Found that the rent increase in the Fernandez vs. Garden Homes Management Corporation complaint is fair and equitable; motion passed by unanimous approval.

Recorded the agreement between Barbara Hax and Lawrence Zolnik, including that the Complainant will vacate the premises no later than November 30, 2026, rent will be $1,250.00 starting September 2026, the Respondent may serve an early Notice to Quit without it being considered retaliation, the Respondent will communicate with Scott Hax about issues, and rent will only be due for actual occupancy if the Complainant vacates early; both parties confirmed this is their agreement.
transcript:
# FAIR RENT COMMISSION

## MINUTES
## OF SPECIAL MEETING

## AUGUST 12, 2026

A Special Meeting of the Fair Rent Commission of the Town of Wallingford was held on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. in Room 315 of the Wallingford Town Hall, 45 South Main Street, Wallingford, Connecticut.

Meeting called to order at 6:30 p.m.

In attendance: Chairman Adam Della Ventura, Vice-Chair Myklyn Mahoney, Rose Longo-McLean, Amy Allesi Raup, Whitney Mooney, Lisa Anne Perretta and Michael F. Terrace.

Also present: Corporation Counsel Janis M. Small
Assistant Town Attorney Steven M. Allinson

1. **Complaint made by Joan Fernandez against Garden Homes Management Corporation.**

   a. Hearing: Complainant Joan Fernandez appeared and testified. Respondent Garden Homes Management Corporation appeared by Brian Daley and testified. Both parties presented testimony relating to the complaint.

   b. Deliberation and Decision: After hearing all testimony and deliberation:

   Motion made to find that the rent increase is fair and equitable under the circumstances by Myklyn Mahoney, seconded by Rose Longo-McLean.

   Vote: Unanimous approval of motion.

2. **Complaint made by Barbara Hax against Lawrence Zolnik**

   Complainant Barbara Hax and the Respondent Lawrence Zolnik appeared and presented an agreement to the Commission. The parties agreed to the following:

   a. Complainant will vacate the premises no later than November 30, 2026;

   b. Beginning in September, 2026, rent shall be $1,250.00;

   c. Parties agree that Respondent may serve a Notice to Quit early and it will not be considered retaliation.

   d. Respondent will communicate with Scott Hax to address any issues;

   e. If the Complainant vacates the premises prior to November 30, 2026, rent will only be due for the occupancy of the premises.

   The Chairman canvased both parties who stated on the record that this is their agreement.

3. **Adjournment**. There being no other business, the meeting adjourned at 7:35 p.m.

Dated: August 13, 2026
